{{Quote|Salvo implied that the order came from high up.''"<br />"''That can only mean the Office of the Supreme Chancellor.|[[Roan Shryne]] and [[Bol Chatak]]|<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
The '''Office of the Supreme Chancellor'''<ref name="Dark Lord" /> or '''Supreme Chancellor's Office''' had two meanings. The first referred to the institution and position of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] itself.

The second, more common, meaning was the combined [[Aide/Legends|aides]], staff, and government organizations directly subordinate to the Chancellor. It could therefore be considered a combination of executive cabinet and personal staff to the Chancellor, and as the de facto (if not de jure) executive branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The Office of the Chancellor had both official, standing subsections/positions, and positions and officials which each Chancellor brought to their Office. The [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]], [[Red Guard|Chancellor's Guard]], [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Senior Administrative Aide]], and presumably the [[Republic Measures & Standards Bureau]], were all standing bodies of the Office of the Supreme Chancellor, regardless of who held the office.

After the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by Palpatine, and by extension, the title Supreme Chancellor altered into [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], the office was renamed the [[Office of the Emperor]].

==Composition==
During the last decades of the Republic, [[Frix]] served as Supreme Chancellor before [[Kalpana (Supreme Chancellor)/Legends|Kalpana]] succeeded him. Frix's office allowed a lot of corruption to enter the senate and number of greedy delegates increased.

During the rule of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as Supreme Chancellor, the Office of Supreme Chancellor became very unpopular and Valorum's administration was removed by a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] put forward by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

===Under Valorum===
Members of the Office under Finis Valorum included:
*[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]
*[[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]]
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Advisor

Organizations under the Chancellorship of Finis Valorum included:
*[[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]]
*[[Coruscant Health Office/Legends|Coruscant Health Administration]]
*[[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]
*[[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]
*[[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]
*[[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Ministry of Science]]
*[[Trade Commission]] (possibly)
*[[Republic Measures & Standards Bureau]]
*[[Republic Spacelane Bureau]]
*[[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]
*[[Senate Guard committee/Legends|Senate Guard committee]]
*[[Senate Support Services]]

===Under Palpatine===
During the tenure of Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the authority and composition of the Office were greatly expanded, due to the numerous crises of the time. At the dawn of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Office of the Supreme Chancellor consisted of:

[[File:Palpatine_Sets_Army_Vote_Date.png|thumb|right|294px|Palpatine's Administration]]
*[[Sim Aloo/Legends|Sim Aloo]], Advisor
*[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]
*[[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], Administrative Aide
*[[Uv Gizen]], Aide<ref name="AotC noveliation">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>
*[[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]], Advisor
*[[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]
*[[Ishin-Il-Raz]], [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|COMPOR]] Director
*[[Jannie Ha'Nook]], Senator of [[Glithnos]]
*[[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]], [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]]
*[[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], Chairman of the Senate Executive Agenda
*[[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]], [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]] of [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Representative to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]
*[[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]], Advisor
*[[Dar Wac/Legends|Dar Wac]], Executive Administrator

Organizations added under Palpatine included:
*[[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]
*[[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]]
*[[Homeworld Security Command]]
*[[Red Guard]]
*[[Republic Domestic Security]]
*[[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]]
*[[War Council Advisory Panel/Legends|War Council Advisory Panel]]
*[[Internal Security Bureau/Legends|Internal Security Bureau]]

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', after completing the Legacy of the Rakata Flashpoint as the [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] player character, the player receives an in-game mail message addressed from the Office of the Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Ore" />
